steps.name: Motivated Student
steps.text: Sorry, Frau Giallo. I made another mistake.

steps.name: Arturia
steps.text: Why did you stop?

steps.name: Motivated Student
steps.text: I don't think I played the last bar on the last line very well...

steps.name: Arturia
steps.text: Your heart is in the right place. Don't let yourself be bound by the melody. Instead, guide it with your will.

steps.name: Motivated Student
steps.text: I can't help but think about what I did wrong though.

steps.name: Arturia
steps.text: Then don't hold yourself back.

steps.name: Arturia
steps.text: Music is the voice of your heart. It's a language to express yourself with. If you let yourself be caught up in the grammar before learning how to speak, then language itself loses all meaning.

steps.name: Arturia
steps.text: Your embarrassment, your self-doubt, and your thirst for the future... They're all real. So let them live in the sound of your instrument.

steps.name: Motivated Student
steps.text: But that's not what my Arts professor said.

steps.name: Motivated Student
steps.text: He said that Originium Arts is a rigorous field of study. That it's about uncovering the order within chaos, like putting together a mess of unrelated notes to form a beautiful chord.

steps.name: Motivated Student
steps.text: But I'm having too many distracting thoughts, and my sound is all over the place. That's why I can't control the energy of my Arts well.

steps.name: Arturia
steps.text: I taught another student just like you before. He was reserved, shy, and not very good at expressing himself.

steps.name: Motivated Student
steps.text: Wh-What happened to him?

steps.name: Arturia
steps.text: He became a very brave man.

steps.name: Arturia
steps.text: A shame that he couldn't live the longer, more beautiful life I'd hoped he would.

steps.name: Arturia
steps.text: But I was fortunate enough to hear his last performance. The cry of his instrument... was hardly inferior to the famed musician with whom he shared a surname.

steps.name: Motivated Student
steps.text: Oh, was he the descendant of someone famous?

steps.name: Arturia
steps.text: Herkunftshorn. Have you heard his work?

steps.name: Motivated Student
steps.text: Who... did you just say?

steps.name: Arturia
steps.text: People often call him the Witch King.

steps.name: Motivated Student
steps.text: Th-That Witch King? *cough*... People hardly ever call him by name.

spans.text: Witch King? *cough*... People hardly ever call him by name.

steps.name: Arturia
steps.text: Really? But to me, he was first and foremost a musician.

steps.name: Motivated Student
steps.text: Uh... Everyone says he stopped performing with regular instruments toward the end of his life.

steps.name: Motivated Student
steps.text: His music... No, you could hardly call that noise music... They say it instilled fear in anyone who heard it.

steps.name: Arturia
steps.text: True. His rhythm was in no way harmonious. Every last measure far exceeded what his audience imagined based on the previous one.

steps.name: Arturia
steps.text: But I'd never felt such a strong... will.

steps.name: Motivated Student
steps.text: You really shouldn't talk about this on campus.

steps.name: Motivated Student
steps.text: I heard the Empresses' Voice and the Gendarmerie keep a close eye on Ludwigs-Universität. You'd be in deep trouble if they were to catch wind of it.

steps.name: Arturia
steps.text: You should return to your dorm.

steps.name: Arturia
steps.text: Keep practicing this piece. No matter what commotion you may hear outside, focus only on your own rhythm.

steps.name: Strange Voice From a Sculpture
steps.text: Arturia.

steps.name: Arturia
steps.text: So it's you. If you're here to speak to me personally, then I take it the show is about to begin?

steps.name: Strange Voice From a Sculpture
steps.text: Almost. Our guests are arriving as they should, one by one.

steps.name: Strange Voice From a Sculpture
steps.text: Will you be performing everything that will happen today for me, just like you used to? I'd like to be present when the melody begins.

steps.name: Arturia
steps.text: You wish to listen from beginning to end? I'm afraid that would be a very long piece.

steps.name: Strange Voice From a Sculpture
steps.text: A lot of people will be hurt today. Some will even die. They will be sacrificed because of me, and I cannot allow myself to look away.

steps.name: Arturia
steps.text: Even though it hurts so much. You're far more determined than anyone.

steps.name: Arturia
steps.text: You... When my performance reaches the end of your life, what will I see?

steps.name: Viviana
steps.text: Ludwigs-Universität.

steps.name: Viviana
steps.text: I've seen the name in more than a few books I've read. Most recently... in a leading publication on Originium Arts theory. But the name comes up as early as ancient scrolls engraved with secret Arts.

steps.name: Viviana
steps.text: The crest of that university shines brilliantly in the history of Leithanien's Arts.

steps.name: Gesatzswächter
steps.text: It's merely a variant of the Urtica family crest.

steps.name: Viviana
steps.text: But it remains Leithanien's oldest university.

steps.name: Viviana
steps.text: Once, I used to fantasize about life on a campus like this.

steps.name: Viviana
steps.text: Walking through a campus covered with red leaves, surrounded by friends of similar ages, with an endless buffet of books and literature in the library... Every day must be fulfilling here.

steps.name: Gesatzswächter
steps.text: With Their Majesties' permission, you are free to enroll in any school in Leithanien.

steps.name: Viviana
steps.text: Oh... have you noticed the eyes of the students walking around us?

steps.name: Viviana
steps.text: Their thirst for knowledge is enough for them to forget the divide between their upbringings.

steps.name: Viviana
steps.text: Yet before Kurfürst Ludwig chose to make his spire a 'university,' all knowledge was locked away by decree.

steps.name: Viviana
steps.text: So... how can I bring myself to use that very same authority to pollute such unique purity once more?

steps.name: Viviana
steps.text: ...The Gendarmerie?

steps.name: Gesatzswächter
steps.text: Your so-called purity has never really existed.

steps.name: Viviana
steps.text: Did you summon them here?

steps.name: Gesatzswächter
steps.text: I wouldn't need to. The eyes up on the Spires have never looked away from Leithanien's lands.

steps.name: Gesatzswächter
steps.text: And especially not from here. Before you lies the oldest spire in the Urtica territory. The Witch King stayed in it for a decade, and often returned even after his coronation.

steps.name: Gesatzswächter
steps.text: The campus may seem peaceful from the outside, but every centimeter of this place can be traced back to the Witch King.

steps.name: Gesatzswächter
steps.text: And that includes the man we're looking for.

steps.name: Viviana
steps.text: Herr Gerhard Hoffmann?

steps.name: Gesatzswächter
steps.text: Nein. We will find his teacher first. He's the one most familiar with Ludwigs-Universität.

steps.name: Gesatzswächter
steps.text: Since the era of the Witch King... No, since an even more distant past, he's never left this school's most ancient spire.

steps.name: Micha
steps.text: ...Why are there so many gendarmes on campus?

steps.name: Federico
steps.text: You said earlier that I was a wanted criminal.

steps.name: Micha
steps.text: You think they're here for you? No way... Besides, we've been very careful on the way. There's no way we got their attention.

steps.name: Micha
steps.text: Quick. Find a place to hide!

steps.name: Gendarmerie
steps.text: Team 5, Team 6, move up.

steps.name: Gendarmerie
steps.text: Team 4, search the whole spire. Do not let any suspicious characters through.

steps.name: Bewildered Student
steps.text: Stop! You can't just run around and use Arts like you own the place.

steps.name: Bewildered Student
steps.text: This is a university. A lot of the research we do here requires a stable environment.

steps.name: Bewildered Student
steps.text: Even the slightest disturbance could cause irreversible damage to the sophisticated equipment and the complicated Arts that have been cast.

steps.name: Gendarmerie
steps.text: Seize him.

steps.name: Bewildered Student
steps.text: Why? I didn't break any laws!

steps.name: Gendarmerie
steps.text: Your name.

steps.name: Bewildered Student
steps.text: Louis. Louis Schnitzler—You haven't answered my question!

steps.name: Gendarmerie
steps.text: The Schnitzlers of Fortsgard? Take him to the classrooms.

steps.name: Bewildered Student
steps.text: I don't understand...

steps.name: Gendarmerie
steps.text: Keep searching.

steps.name: Gendarmerie
steps.text: Take any commoners to the courtyard, and lock the nobles in the classrooms.

steps.name: Gendarmerie
steps.text: Take control of anyone and anything related to House Urtica.

steps.name: Bewildered Student
steps.text: I'm only a Schnitzler by name! My father didn't even inherit the title. What gives you the right to do all this over something that happened decades ago—

steps.name: Gendarmerie
steps.text: Because we're investigating what happened decades ago.

steps.name: Gendarmerie
steps.text: Young Herr Schnitzler. As long as you behave yourself, I assure you nothing will happen to you.

steps.name: Bewildered Student
steps.text: My family will be participating in the celebration soon! I'm going to have an audience with Their Majesties!

steps.name: Bewildered Student
steps.text: Ludwigs-Universität is the most historic university in Leithanian! Not even the Kaiserinnen's armies dared damage a single brick of this spire twenty-three years ago!

steps.name: Bewildered Student
steps.text: What gives you the right to trample on knowledge and the arts, on Leithanien's traditions?!

steps.name: Gendarmerie
steps.text: The Kaiserinnen's orders, young Herr.

steps.name: Gendarmerie
steps.text: The culprit who murdered our commander is hiding in this school.

steps.name: Gendarmerie
steps.text: If you want to protect it, then tell all your classmates that they'd better report anything they know about a strange Sankta and the Witch King's remains.

steps.name: Micha
steps.text: The Kaiserinnen's orders...?

steps.name: Micha
steps.text: No way...

steps.name: Federico
steps.text: You seem surprised.

steps.name: Micha
steps.text: Surprised? No, I'm just an idiot. Given her personality and disposition, how could I have thought she'd keep herself at arm's length?

steps.name: Micha
steps.text: I can't waste time chasing after Arturia anymore.

steps.name: Federico
steps.text: I thought she was the target of your mission too.

steps.name: Micha
steps.text: Only part of it. My... client wants to understand the reasoning behind her actions, in order to prevent her from getting in the way of our plans.

steps.name: Micha
steps.text: But now there's a bigger problem. I can't let this ruin the plan itself.

steps.name: Micha
steps.text: You...

steps.name: Federico
steps.text: I have no further questions. As you are Leithanian, I will not be required to execute your will.

steps.name: Micha
steps.text: Forget it. Not like I was expecting anything resembling a goodbye from you.

steps.name: Micha
steps.text: Herr Executor, the case Arturia is involved in is far more serious than you could ever imagine. Even your pope has no right to interfere.

steps.name: Micha
steps.text: Here's some advice: abandon your mission before the Gendarmerie make it here. Leave Zwillingstürme.

steps.name: Federico
steps.text: I've completed my assessment.

steps.name: Federico
steps.text: Abandoning this mission is not an option.

steps.name: Gesatzswächter
steps.text: We've arrived, Droste. You'd best wait outside.

steps.name: Viviana
steps.text: Hm? I sense no danger...
Don't move.

steps.name: Viviana
steps.text: ...What?
You're blocking my pipe. Yes, the one puffing out smoke to your left. If you move, I can't guarantee that your left hand will remain after the smoke ring passes.

steps.name: Viviana
steps.text: You use a smoking pipe as a wand?

This? A wand? Don't be ridiculous. I smoke to relax. Who'd want to think about serious matters while smoking? I simply wanted run an experiment, and see if this smoke ring could float all the way to the top of the twin sheep's spire.

steps.name: Gesatzswächter
steps.text: ...We're here because we have important matters to discuss, Herr Fremont.

steps.name: Fremont
steps.text: What a killjoy, Reiner. If only you were as well-behaved as the lovely little doe next to you.

steps.name: Viviana
steps.text: I'd also be interested in seeing if a smoke ring could float for dozens of kilometers.

steps.name: Fremont
steps.text: No, distance isn't the important factor. What matters is... not being blinded by that uselessly shiny armor of yours.

steps.name: Fremont
steps.text: Alright, so you've ruined my mood. Now tell me, was it the gloomy sheep or the boastful sheep that asked you to come find me?

steps.name: Fremont
steps.text: So you're telling me a copy of the Güldenesgesatz was lost. The one stored in Sturmwind.

steps.name: Fremont
steps.text: Do we pay you to sit around all day?! You're the Gesatzswächter, and you can't even keep an eye on the Güldenesgesatz. What good is that fancy getup of yours, other than being hung from the top of the Spires as an ornament?

steps.name: Fremont
steps.text: Seriously, that Grimmacht. 'It's safer to keep it far away from the center of whirlpool'? Apparently, some of your idiocy rubbed off on her! Maybe the bigger your horns, the stupider you get!

steps.name: Fremont
steps.text: And don't get me started with that punk in Sturmwind! Honor his vow with his life? Like hell he did!

steps.name: Gesatzswächter
steps.text: Kurfürst Werner has passed.

steps.name: Gesatzswächter
steps.text: Before you stands his daughter.

steps.name: Viviana
steps.text: It's a pleasure.

steps.name: Fremont
steps.text: My condolences, if you want them. But that doesn't change the fact that this whole farce is the height of absurdity! Especially the fact that Grimmacht waited until now to tell me!

spans.text: My condolences, if you want them. But that doesn't change the fact that this whole farce is the height of absurdity! Especially the fact that Grimmacht waited until

steps.name: Viviana
steps.text: Is this stolen Güldenesgesatz really so special?

steps.name: Gesatzswächter
steps.text: Twenty-three years ago, when Kurfürst Werner returned from Zwillingstürme to Sturmland, he had it on his person.

steps.name: Gesatzswächter
steps.text: Aside from the Kaiserinnen and the Kurfürsten, no one wanted to be near it. My guess is that, like many of the Arts devices from the era of the Witch King, his Arts still remain in it.

steps.name: Fremont
steps.text: The Witch King's Arts... The Witch King's Arts!

steps.name: Fremont
steps.text: The entrance of Ludwigs-Universität has that fool's Arts, too. They could have all the armors lining the streets start breakdancing right this moment—but is there a point?

steps.name: Fremont
steps.text: Did Grimmacht never mention it? Those are no normal, frivolous Arts. They're Arts devices that Herkunftshorn himself spent his life developing, all to defeat his greatest foe!

steps.name: Viviana
steps.text: The Witch King's greatest foe... Do you mean Corsica I of Gaul?

steps.name: Fremont
steps.text: A mere emperor, leading a mere army. Do you really think transient might like that would have meant a thing to Herkunftshorn in his heyday?

steps.name: Fremont
steps.text: The enemy he defeated all those years ago was the will of Leithanien.

steps.name: Gesatzswächter
steps.text: ...The Güldenesgesatz.

steps.name: Fremont
steps.text: Apparently you aren't a complete moron. Ever since the birth of the Leithanian Empire, the Güldenesgesatz has changed only once.

spans.text: moron. Ever since the birth of the Leithanian Empire, the Güldenesgesatz has changed only once.

steps.name: Fremont
steps.text: All on his own, Herkunftshorn issued a challenge to Leithanien's forebears, as well as to all the Arts masters who put their energy into composing the Güldenesgesatz.

steps.name: Gerhard
steps.text: How do you feel?

steps.name: Ebenholz
steps.text: My head... hah... It doesn't hurt as much anymore.

steps.name: Gerhard
steps.text: I'm afraid normal healing Arts won't help you very much. Your pain isn't caused by physical injuries.

steps.name: Ebenholz
steps.text: I know. There's an evil old fart shouting my ear off. That's all.

steps.name: Gerhard
steps.text: You... You can actually hear him speak?

steps.name: Ebenholz
steps.text: Occasionally.

steps.name: Gerhard
steps.text: That must be unbearable. Like his melodies, the Witch King's voice holds a power that is difficult to endure.

steps.name: Gerhard
steps.text: If he wanted, he could kill a man simply by humming.

steps.name: Ebenholz
steps.text: You've met him?

steps.name: Gerhard
steps.text: My teacher, Herr Fremont, was once the Witch King's closest friend.

steps.name: Gerhard
steps.text: When he sat atop the Witch King's Spire, there were once thousands of casters prostrating themselves before the steps to the throne. And I... I was one of them.

steps.name: Ebenholz
steps.text: So you're also...

steps.name: Ebenholz
steps.text: Ugh!

steps.name: Gerhard
steps.text: Is your head hurting again? Don't worry. I betrayed him in the end. I joined the resistance, and charged into the Spire under Grimmacht and Ewigegnade's leadership.

steps.name: Gerhard
steps.text: That day, the steps I once kneeled before were... redder than even the leaves in the Ludwigs-Universität campus.

steps.name: Ebenholz
steps.text: It must have been a difficult battle.

steps.name: Gerhard
steps.text: For every ten companions I fought beside, only one survived... Every last one of us was among the most capable in the country.

steps.name: Gerhard
steps.text: If they had been as fortunate as me, they would have gone on to become even more outstanding scholars, even greater casters.

steps.name: Ebenholz
steps.text: No wonder you visited Forest Park that day. I should salute you and those who sacrificed their lives.

steps.name: Gerhard
steps.text: Don't waste your strength... I'm not worth it.

steps.name: Gerhard
steps.text: If it hurts, though, feel free to lean on me.

steps.name: Lessing
steps.text: Let him go.

steps.name: Ebenholz
steps.text: Lessing...?

steps.name: Gerhard
steps.text: I knew you'd come after us.

steps.name: Gerhard
steps.text: Where's Professor Fremont?

steps.name: Lessing
steps.text: He's very disappointed in you.

steps.name: Gerhard
steps.text: I'm sorry, Lessing. I don't want to hurt you, nor do I want to make an enemy of my dear teacher.

steps.name: Lessing
steps.text: Then why stop us?

steps.name: Gerhard
steps.text: The Genesis Horn should not arrive like this.

steps.name: Lessing
steps.text: We're not pursuing any evil causes. We're simply retrieving what belongs to us and destroying what hinders us. You know that.

steps.name: Gerhard
steps.text: The Witch King's relics... Who do they belong to? And who decides that?

steps.name: Gerhard
steps.text: You're a smart fellow, Lessing, and an honest one. You should think about these things, lest you regret all this in twenty or thirty years. I see you as my favorite student, which is why I don't want to see you make the same mistakes.

steps.name: Lessing
steps.text: I once... saw you as a dear mentor too.

steps.name: Gerhard
steps.text: I still remember. You weren't even half as tall as you are now when Professor Fremont handed that sword to you.

steps.name: Gerhard
steps.text: Yet in the blink of an eye, you're as old as I was when I stormed the Witch King's Spire.

steps.name: Gerhard
steps.text: In school, time really does fly right by, doesn't it?

steps.name: Lessing
steps.text: My fear is that not enough time has passed. That I'm not strong or worthy enough to raise my sword for those I want to protect.

spans.text: time has passed. That I'm not strong or worthy enough to raise my sword for those I want to protect.

steps.name: Ebenholz
steps.text: I'm your target, remnant of the Witch King.

steps.name: Ebenholz
steps.text: And I have only one thing to say to you: Get out of my way.

steps.name: Gerhard
steps.text: Classes are almost over.

steps.name: Gerhard
steps.text: Come, this way!

steps.name: Passing Student
steps.text: Maeyer, what are you doing standing here? Not auditing any lectures today?

steps.name: Passing Student
steps.text: Ahem... Why are you holding a sword in the school building? You really love training, don't you?

steps.name: Lessing
steps.text: ...He chose this path on purpose.

steps.name: Passing Student
steps.text: Have you heard? A large group of gendarmes barged into the school today. They're searching everyone they're coming across, especially commoners from the Urtica territory—

steps.name: Passing Student
steps.text: Hold on, why are you running so fast? Even up the stairs? The school administration doesn't allow that!

steps.name: Gerhard
steps.text: Are you okay? Why waste your strength on me? I'm much older than you. I should be the one protecting you.

spans.text: Are you okay? Why waste your strength on me? I'm much older than you. I should be the one protecting

steps.name: Ebenholz
steps.text: Haa... Haa... Well, I'm the one he's after. Besides, I don't want to see any more blood spilled on my account.

steps.name: Gerhard
steps.text: Considering Lessing's abilities and temperament, he'll catch up to us soon.

steps.name: Gerhard
steps.text: We need to take a safer route.

steps.name: Ebenholz
steps.text: Are we inside a school?

steps.name: Gerhard
steps.text: Ludwigs-Universität.

steps.name: Gerhard
steps.text: You are of the Urtica bloodline. If the Witch King hadn't fallen when you were born, you would have studied Arts here.

steps.name: Ebenholz
steps.text: ...I'd really wish I weren't.

steps.name: Gerhard
steps.text: The Urticas have produced more than one Leithanian ruler. Aside from Herkunftshorn and the other Kaisers...

steps.name: Gerhard
steps.text: Ludwig. Known as the Scholar, he was the Kurfürst of Einwald, and he too almost became the Kaiser of Leithanien. And he was also your ancestor.

steps.name: Gerhard
steps.text: He wanted everyone to 'gain the most supreme knowledge,' so that the land would 'never again impede Leithanien.'

steps.name: Gerhard
steps.text: When he insisted on opening up his family's spire to all of Einwald's citizens, many thought he'd gone mad.

steps.name: Ebenholz
steps.text: Mad... Heh. I suppose a lot of our family get called that.

steps.name: Gerhard
steps.text: Madness goes hand-in-hand with greatness. This has always been the way of House Urtica. Even the Witch King was a benevolent ruler of unsurpassed talent, before he succumbed to his madness.

steps.name: Ebenholz
steps.text: 'Succumbing to madness' has far more frightening connotations when it happens to a tyrant rather than a commoner.

steps.name: Ebenholz
steps.text: If that's another Urtica tradition, then I'll have to find somewhere to bleed out before it happens to me.

steps.name: Gerhard
steps.text: From the moment I laid eyes on you, I saw the bravery in you. But your life is precious, and self-destruction has never been the only path open to you.

steps.name: Gerhard
steps.text: Franz... May I call you Franz?

steps.name: Ebenholz
steps.text: You know the name I threw away?

steps.name: Gerhard
steps.text: You won't ever be alone again. Let me help you.

steps.name: Fremont
steps.text: ...Gerhard Hoffmann.

steps.name: Fremont
steps.text: Of all my students, he's the one who knows best what the Güldenesgesatz really is.

steps.name: Fremont
steps.text: If only he were here. Then I wouldn't need to waste my energy explaining all this.

steps.name: Viviana
steps.text: How did you know our purpose here?

steps.name: Fremont
steps.text: Purpose?

steps.name: Viviana
steps.text: The Witch King's remains killed my father, as well as two more who participated in the coup twenty-three years ago.

steps.name: Viviana
steps.text: We suspect that their next target is Herr Hoffmann.

steps.name: Fremont
steps.text: Hoh, you came at just the right time, then. Just fifteen minutes ago... Wait, what did you just say?

steps.name: Fremont
steps.text: Gerhard is involved with the Witch King's remains? The same 'remains' that experimented on Herkunftshorn's great-grandson simply to blow up a dime-a-dozen music hall?

steps.name: Gesatzswächter
steps.text: ...I suppose so. They may not be the exact same group, but they're working under a similar banner.

steps.name: Gesatzswächter
steps.text: But how do you know so much about even the finest details of the Vyseheim Incident?

steps.name: Gesatzswächter
steps.text: This energy fluctuation... It's a sign that Arts were cast to maintain structural integrity here.

steps.name: Gesatzswächter
steps.text: The same kind of Arts used by Einwald's caster army.

steps.name: Fremont
steps.text: Don't mistake my Arts for their child's play.

steps.name: Fremont
steps.text: Forget the Einwald of today, even when Herkunftshorn was still around, I was the one who taught all his lackeys their spatial Arts!

spans.text: Forget the Einwald of today, even when Herkunftshorn was still around,
was the one who taught all his lackeys their spatial Arts!

steps.name: Gesatzswächter
steps.text: Stand back, Droste.

steps.name: Fremont
steps.text: Why are you reaching for your blade? Stay away from my instruments. It's been centuries since this spire was last repaired, and it can't withstand being knocked around.

steps.name: Gesatzswächter
steps.text: ...Herr Fremont.

steps.name: Gesatzswächter
steps.text: Is the experiment you were just conducting related to the Voice of Mundane?
